findings.failing_input: `Math.round((toMs - fromMs) / 86400000) + 1` — if range spans IL DST transition while fromMs/toMs are UTC-anchored ISO strings, division by 86400000 (24h) is exact since UTC has no DST. Correct.

`amount = (r.monthlyCAD * days) / 30` uses 30 as the days-per-month constant. For 31-day months (e.g. May 2026 has 31 days), this slightly overstates; for 28-day months (Feb), slightly understates. Documented behavior (proration), not a bug.
findings.fix_sketch: If precise calendar-month proration needed, divide by daysInMonth(month) of fromMs.
